full_judgment:
Mr. Khademul Islam Chowdhury, J:- The Rule under Article 102 of the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh calls upon the respondents to show cause the impugned as to why notification Annexure-D published in the Daily Ittefaq dated 7.9.94 and treating the petitioner's land situated in Touzi No. 61 Mouza No. 291 Badda, C.S. Khatian No. 157 and in C. S. Plot No. 1004 of Gulshan, Dhaka as requisitioned under L.A. Case No. 138/61-62 shall not be declared to have been made without lawful authority and is of no legal effect or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 5. At the time of the hearing today the petitioner has filed a supplementary affidavit annexing the receipts for payment of land development tax rent marked as Annexure-X and XI to show that he is in possession on payment of up-to date rent and she has also annexed to the writ petition copy of S.A. Khatian No. 161/ 1-1 for mutation and separation of jama of the land in her name vide Annexure-C to the writ petition.
